name: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

angles.text: Lowlands galestriders yield hearty tenderloins for a substantial hot meal, a welcome change from lean harvests and fruit.
As a hunter, watch for the powerful kicks and aggressive temper of lowlands galestriders. They differ from their highland kin.

faq.answer: Galestriders raid the orchard for stormapples. With the harvest already meager, their feeding threatens the local food supply.
faq.q: Why are the galestriders causing problems for the farmer?

faq.answer: Lowlands galestriders are larger and more aggressive than their highland kin. Their powerful kicks can kill a traveler caught off guard.
The farmer wants travelers to cull aggressive lowlands galestriders and collect their tenderloins for dinner.
faq.q: What does the farmer want from the galestriders?

faq.answer: Ornery lowlands galestriders roam the Gustberry Lowlands, especially near farmsteads and orchards where they forage for stormapples.
Lowlands galestriders are larger and more ill-tempered than their highland kin. Their kicks can badly injure a traveler.
faq.q: How do lowlands galestriders compare to highlands galestriders?

faq.answer: Stormapples are an orchard crop grown in the region. With the harvest scarce, the remaining trees need protection from foraging galestriders.

sections.body: A poor harvest has left Gustberry Lowlands farmers with little to spare. Now wild galestriders strip ripe stormapples from orchard branches and threaten what fruit remains. The farmer needs the boldest birds driven off or culled before the crop is gone.
sections.title: Defending the Orchard

sections.body: Lowlands galestriders are larger and more bad-tempered than their highland kin. Take care near these towering birds, traveler; one powerful kick can badly hurt or kill a fighter. Their tenderloins give hungry locals a rare, substantial meal.
sections.title: Lowland Terrors

summary: In the Gustberry Lowlands, an orchard farmer's poor harvest is under threat from galestriders raiding the stormapples. Drive off the boldest birds to save the remaining fruit and bring home tenderloins for dinner.
attribution: In-game quest text: Ornery Ornery Galestriders
